# clavis connections rotate

<p class="cli-lead">Replace a connection&#39;s credential (or rename it / change its URL)</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis connections rotate ID [flags]
```

</div>

Replace a connection's credential, or rename it or change its URL. Every sync that uses it picks up the new value.
